summary: Focused retest of the 2 issues from iter-11: (1) radar-briefing SKIP button clickable via normal click, and (2) SplashScreen SVG height='auto' console warning. BOTH FIXES CONFIRMED WORKING. Plus regression smoke on Command Center Layer 2. All 8 retest assertions PASS.

svg_height_auto_warning.detail: Loaded / (splash screen) and captured all console messages during the 3.5s hold. SVG height/auto warnings count = 0 (was 2 in iter-11). Removed height='auto' attr from <svg> in SplashScreen.jsx confirmed effective.

skip_button_hit_test.detail: document.elementFromPoint(640, 222) at SKIP button center returns { tagName: 'BUTTON', data-testid: 'radar-briefing-skip', class: 'radar-briefing__skip', isButtonOrDescendant: true }. Previously returned the war-room-scene DIV. Rect: x=598.04 y=208.75 w=83.92 h=26.61.

skip_button_normal_click_unmounts.detail: page.click() (NON-force) on [data-testid='radar-briefing-skip'] → briefing removed from DOM within ~100ms (well under the 500ms budget). Verified via locator.count() == 0.

regression_widgets_and_menu.detail: tutorial widget present (1), tactical-scout widget present (1), hamburger button present (1). Hamburger opens panel, ESC closes panel. No console errors on /dashboard flow (0 errors, 0 pageerrors).

regression_operations_page.detail: /operations loads correctly with existing Navbar (2 nav/header elements found), Alliance HQ content visible.

critical_code_review_comments: CSS fix in CommandCenter.css is clean: mask-image moved to inner .radar-briefing__scroll wrapper, container padding-bottom: 2.6rem creates skip room, .radar-briefing__skip repositioned to bottom: 8px with explicit z-index: 5 and pointer-events: auto. Good defensive layering.
SplashScreen.jsx: relies on width='100%' + preserveAspectRatio + viewBox + maxHeight style for aspect-correct sizing — works and no more SVG attribute warnings.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-11's single HIGH bug and MINOR cosmetic warning are both fully resolved. Command Center Layer 2 is at 100% functional. Viewport used: 1280x720. Splash still holds ~3s before dashboard renders; radar briefing appears immediately on /dashboard after splash, SKIP button is now fully interactive at bottom: 8px inside the (now unmasked) container.
rca_of_the_issue: Original RCA (iter-11): CSS mask-image on .radar-briefing made outer regions non-hittable in Blink; SKIP button at bottom:-14px was in the fully-transparent mask zone. Fix applied by main agent (verified): (a) moved -webkit-mask-image/mask-image OFF .radar-briefing and ONTO inner .radar-briefing__scroll wrapper, (b) added padding-bottom: 2.6rem to container to make room, (c) moved .radar-briefing__skip from bottom:-14px to bottom:8px with explicit z-index:5 and pointer-events:auto. Result: elementFromPoint now returns the BUTTON element itself and a normal (non-force) click cleanly unmounts the briefing within ~100ms.
